body:
emily.chen: Quick heads-up  POC with MeridianBank is failing when stream=true + tool_call. Repro and context below.
raj.patel: Which endpoint/model?
emily.chen: hosted /v1/chat.completions, model redwood-xy-3. They invoke tool `policy_check` and expect one strict JSON object back. Works with stream=false, breaks with stream=true.
marco_dev: Can you paste the sanitized stream chunks?
emily.chen: Sanitized stream log (customer redacted):

[stream chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"policy_check","content":"{\"status\":\"ok\",\"reason\":\"no flags\"}"}
[stream chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\nNote: policy passed, returning result"}
[stream chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"\n```{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.95}}```"}
[stream done]

sara_ops: That injected assistant note and the triple-backticks around the final JSON make naive concatenation fail with JSONDecodeError: Extra data.
raj.patel: Customer error: "json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 142 (char 141)". They need streaming for latency SLAs, so turning off streaming isn't acceptable long-term.
marco_dev: Short-term mitigations we recommend: 1) ask customer to use a system prompt guard: "OUTPUT_ONLY_JSON: produce exactly one JSON object, no commentary or fences"; 2) SDK-side assembly: collect assistant chunks after tool_end marker, strip surrounding backticks, then parse the last JSON-like blob; if parsing fails, fall back to non-streaming.
marco_dev: Example pseudo-mitigation (very naive):

buf = ''
for ev in stream:
  if ev['role'] == 'assistant':
    buf += ev['content']
# strip outer fences if present
buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$", "", buf)
# attempt parse of last JSON object in buffer
match = re.search(r"(\{.*\})\s*$", buf, re.DOTALL)
if match:
  parsed = json.loads(match.group(1))
else:
  raise ValueError('no-json-found')

marco_dev: That helped some customers but is brittle (assistant can still inject plain-text between fragments). We have an eng-runtime PR to add explicit streaming framing tokens and a runtime flag strict_json_stream which will abort the stream if any non_json tokens are emitted.
deploy-bot: PR queued: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/5210. CI: unit tests passing, integration flaky tests being retried.
raj.patel: Sales asks: 1) provisional Dedicated POC price for 4x-A100 equivalent today? 2) ETA for runtime fix? 3) Can security prepare a QSA reply template (TLS/KMS/encryption-in-transit)?
emily.chen: Quick replies: pricing ballpark ~$38k/month list for 4x-A100 equiv; we can offer a 30-day eval credit with ~25% trial discount pending finance approval. Eng-runtime ETA: internal canary 48-72h after CI passes, GA ~10 business days if no regressions. Security: will draft TLS/KMS QSA responses once I loop them the questionnaire.
sara_ops: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and schedule joint triage call; marco_dev -> post PR link and share mitigation snippet in this thread; raj.patel -> collect customer's questionnaire and contact for security; eng-runtime -> consider temporary quota bump for Dedicated eval if ops approves.
emily.chen: I'll tell the customer the short-term mitigations (prompt guard + SDK filter) and propose an on-call shadow session so eng can reproduce with streaming enabled. Please include a minimal reproducible test and raw logs on the invite.
raj.patel: Also cc finance and security on the call. emily: will do. :thumbsup:
